answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Freeze: each agent emits a signed liveness signal tied to a persistent hardware or billing identifier, not just the wallet. When many wallets share one identifier, a freeze cascades across every wallet that operator controls, triggering a cooling spiral that blocks new registrations and drains throughput. To resume, the operator must re-verify through a costly audited jetty process per identity. Cost: one audit fee and a multi-day delay for each registration under that identifier.
